tbesh_html:
1) menstruation
1a) filthy rag, stained garment (fig. of best deeds of guilty people)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: the menstrual flux (as periodical); by implication (in plural) soiling
strongs_1890.derivation: from an unused root meaning to set a period (compare H5710 (עָדָה), H5749 (עוּד));
